name: Chilli ginger lamb chops
assumptions: Yield estimated from 8 lamb loin chops at ~200g raw weight per serving (typical restaurant portion for lamb chops); total ~800g lamb yields 4 servings
Marinate time taken as 2 hours (minimum stated); excludes optional overnight
All ingredients screened as listed; no compound sauces or hidden allergens
Gluten-free assumed true as no gluten-containing grains or additives listed
Sesame left null due to possible cross-contamination in unspecified spice powders or shared kitchen equipment
No substitutions applied per dietary notes; lamb is the only animal-derived ingredient
instructions:
step 1
Put the garlic in a bowl with the ginger, lemon juice, oil, spices and seasoning. Blitz with a hand blender until smooth, then use to coat the lamb chops on both sides. Leave to marinate in the fridge for a couple of hours or overnight.

step 2
Heat a barbecue until hot. Barbecue the chops over the coals for 3 mins on each side until cooked but still pink and juicy in the centre.

ingredients.assumptions: 4 average garlic cloves crushed, edible portion ~12g total

ingredients.assumptions: 8 average lamb loin chops, total raw edible meat ~800g (100g each)
